title: KEEP IT
scope_and_limits: Archive paper-folding reference followed by a wholly new synthetic vector puppet. Bracket/unfold, arrow/turn and three-bar/repeat rules organize action. Creases and edge irregularities are authored consequences, not measured paper physics. The puppet keeps its fold, flips the sign-bearing tray to a blank back and declines further compliance. Next periodic repeat cue deliberately omitted. New numerical tones/stylized noise texture are not real foley, bodily recording or archival contact sound. Native audio pressure and cue absence are not perceptually certified.
reference_lineage: David Lynch, The Alphabet (1968), a short combining live action and animation around a nightmare involving living alphabetic forms.

Search results alone are not claimed watched or licensed.
